meta.summary: A browser extension to control your Pi-hole conveniently from within the browser.

description.disclaimer: The extension is not associated with or endorsed by Pi-hole.

blocking.title: Blocking control
blocking.description: Turn blocking on or off with one click, or pause it for anywhere from 10 seconds to an hour and let it switch back on by itself.

currentSite.title: Current site
currentSite.description: See at a glance whether the site you're on is blocked, and by which list, then allowlist or block it in one click.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Allowlist or block any domain, or a whole pattern with regex, without opening the Pi-hole admin interface.

groups.title: Groups and lists
groups.description: Switch groups and blocklists on or off, and update gravity right after.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.description: Keep an eye on today's queries, blocked queries, block rate, and cache hits, each with a 24-hour graph.

systemInfo.title: System info
systemInfo.description: Check your Pi-hole's CPU, memory, temperature, and uptime at a glance.

recentlyBlocked.title: Recently blocked
recentlyBlocked.description: Find out what just got blocked on your device or your whole network, and allowlist it on the spot.

notices.title: Notices
notices.description: Get a heads-up about unread diagnosis messages and available Pi-hole updates right in the popup.

multiInstance.title: Multiple Pi-holes
multiInstance.description: Manage every Pi-hole you run, give each its own icon, and switch between them with one click.

badge.title: Toolbar badge
badge.description: Show the block rate, blocking status, or number of active clients right on the extension icon.

customization.title: Your popup, your way
customization.description: Choose which cards the popup shows, pick your language, and go light or dark.

backup.title: Settings backup
backup.description: Export your settings, import them in another browser, or start over with the defaults.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.quote: This page doesn't exist, or it has moved.
